en.Na Igreja Missão VIDE, Eder lidera o dep: At Igreja Missão VIDE, Eder leads the department responsible for supporting around 20 missionary families in Mozambique, Angola, Tunisia, Spain, France and Brazil.
en.Filho de pastor batista, Eder cresceu em: Son of a Baptist pastor, Eder grew up in a Christian family. At SEBI, he deepened his theological training and approached the Reformed tradition, with an emphasis on the sovereignty of God, the centrality of the Scriptures and grace. The book Give Up Control was born from these studies.
en.Como pastor de missões da Missão VIDE, l: As missions pastor at Missão VIDE, he leads the department responsible for supporting approximately 20 missionary families in several countries.
en.Eder preparou uma pregação sobre superaç: Eder prepared a sermon about overcoming, perseverance and trust in Jesus. The message is not about winning through personal strength, but about trusting in Christ when human possibilities disappear.
en.UpsideDown foi apresentada no Brasil e n: UpsideDown was presented in Brazil and the United States and remains among the messages he considers most important.
en.Eder apresenta este relato não como uma: Eder presents this account not as a story of personal strength, but as the record of an ordinary person who went through a frightening experience and found hope in Jesus Christ.
en.Eder nasceu em uma realidade de grande d: Eder was born into a reality of great difficulty, studied at a public school, started a family and built a career in data and technology. At the age of 43, he was included in an investigation related to the national political scene. His name appeared in more than 200 reports in Brazil and abroad, while estimates released during the investigation mentioned a possible sentence of 16 years.
en.A Gaio, desenvolvedora do Gaio DataOS, f: Gaio, developer of Gaio DataOS, was hired by Instituto Voto Legal to analyze data from the 2022 presidential elections. The institute had been hired by the Liberal Party. The system processed the data and highlighted inconsistencies that became part of the public debate and investigation.
en.A Polícia Federal esteve em sua residênc: The Federal Police visited his residence and took equipment and passports. By decision of Minister Alexandre de Moraes, Eder was prevented from leaving Brazil and had contact restrictions. His wife and four children were present at that moment, in a period marked by apprehension and uncertainty.
en.Após cerca de dez meses, a investigação: After about ten months, the investigation was concluded without Eder being indicted. Subsequently, the Attorney General of the Republic, Paulo Gonet, called him as a witness in the process before the STF. The year 2024 brought together new challenges, fears and personal, family and professional consequences.
en.Durante os dias em que não sabia se seri: During the days when he didn't know if he would be arrested or what would happen to his family, Eder came to understand hope as something that does not depend on circumstances, but on trust in Jesus Christ. The period he describes as a valley of the shadow of death dissolved the feeling of control and turned faith into a concrete experience of refuge.
en.A imagem do bilhete que chega na hora de: The image of the ticket that arrives when boarding became a reference for the period: the necessary strength would arrive along with adversity. Love would also arrive with the invitation to love those who could be seen as enemies, understood in the story as unconscious servants of the Most High.
en.O propósito da vida nunca foi a busca do: The purpose of life has never been the pursuit of pleasure or the escape from pain, but to know the Author.
en.A conclusão apresentada em 111–102 é que: The conclusion presented in 111–102 is that the hope found is not the absence of chaos, but the presence of Someone. Even when events are not understood, Jesus Christ remains faithful. The scars are not presented as trophies, but as reminders of grace and a life that has not remained the same.
en.Cento e onze dias depois de 8 de feverei: One hundred and eleven days after February 8, 2024, the date of the search and seizure, Eder recorded 101 occasions in which he understood that he had been guided by Jesus. On May 28, the 102nd experience became the starting point for publicly sharing what I was experiencing. The meaning was not just in learning to live one day at a time, but in expecting the best from God without assuming what that best would be.
en.O relato menciona o ex-presidente Jair B: The report mentions former president Jair Bolsonaro, STF minister Alexandre de Moraes, the Instituto Voto Legal, the Liberal Party, the Federal Police, the Attorney General's Office and national and international press coverage.
en.Antes da investigação, Eder já havia tra: Before the investigation, Eder had already worked for more than 25 years with data intelligence in companies and public projects, founded technology companies, taught Data Science and participated in Gartner and Informa events.
en.“Por não saber qual será o melhor dele p: “Because I didn’t know what would be his best for me, he took the liberty of imagining and clinging to that hope.”

zh.Após cerca de dez meses, a investigação: 大约十个月后，调查结束，埃德没有被起诉。随后，共和国总检察长 Paulo Gonet 传唤他作为 STF 诉讼过程中的证人。 2024 年带来了新的挑战、恐惧以及个人、家庭和职业后果。
zh.Durante os dias em que não sabia se seri: 在他不知道自己是否会被捕，也不知道家人会发生什么的日子里，埃德开始明白，希望并不取决于环境，而是取决于对耶稣基督的信任。他将这段时期描述为死亡阴影的山谷，溶解了控制感，将信仰转变为具体的避难体验。
